lines.text: Jake Whitmore blocks seventeen-year-old Mia Lane, who wears a medical sling on her recovering left arm.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Sign these corporate transfer papers for me right now, Mia, or your nurse sister Harper never gets another dime for her medical bills.

lines.speaker: MIA
lines.text: Get away from me, you creep, I know your mother Diane poisoned our grandmother Evelyn.

scenes.heading: INT. ST. BRIGID HOSPITAL ER - NIGHT

lines.text: INT. ST. BRIGID HOSPITAL ER - NIGHT
Harper Lane pumps thirty-two-year-old Cole Whitmore's chest as the monitor flatlines after his near-fatal stab wound.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: Don't you dare die on me, Cole, you lying billionaire bastard!

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: (weak gasping) Harper... the flash drive in my auto shop desk... proves Diane killed Evelyn.
Cole's loyal mechanic assistant kicks open the office door to find the security hard drive smashed to pieces.

lines.speaker: MECHANIC
lines.text: Someone broke in and wiped all the video evidence of Diane murdering the matriarch.
Diane Whitmore slides a forged inheritance contract across the mahogany table while laughing maniacally.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: With Cole bleeding out and Harper cornered by Jake, the Whitmore shipping empire is finally mine!
Jake grabs Harper by the wrist in the shadows, shoving the stolen transfer ledger into her face.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Choose now, Harper, sign away the company or watch your little sister Mia die tonight.
